newsitem.title: INDIA: India Shaw Wallace director in custody.
newsitem.headline: India Shaw Wallace director in custody.

text.p: A Calcutta judge rejected the bail plea of a director of Shaw Wallace and Co Ltd on Tuesday and remanded him in judicial custody until December 3 for the alleged violation of foreign exchange laws.
Shaw Wallace executive director P.L. Narasimhan was arrested by the Enforcement Directorate late on Monday.

Calcutta's chief metropolitan magistrate, A.K. Dasgupta, rejected Narasimhan's bail plea, saying "the accused has been charged with violation of foreign exchange rules by siphoning out 700 million rupees from the country".
Narasimhan's arrest was the first by the Enforcement Directorate in its investigation into suspected foreign exchange rule violations by Shaw Wallace.
Earlier, Narasimhan denied a claim by the Enforcement Directorate that he had confessed to any wrongdoing.
"Whatever I have done is under the instructions of my chairman," he told reporters after he was arrested.
The Enforcement Directorate has arrested 12 serving or retired executives of tobacco and hotels group ITC Ltd in a separate investigation into possible violations of foreign exchange rules.
Both Shaw Wallace and ITC have their headquarters in Calcutta.
